requirements.text: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
At least 1 year of professional experience developing software systems in production environments.
Strong programming skills in Python, Java, C++, Go, Rust, or similar languages.
Experience developing distributed systems, backend services, or large-scale platform infrastructure.
Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and deep learning concepts.
Experience working with large-scale data processing systems and distributed computing frameworks.
Understanding of software development best practices, data structures, algorithms, and system design principles.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.
Experience building machine learning platforms, AI infrastructure, or model serving frameworks.
Familiarity with recommendation systems, large language models (LLMs), graph-based machine learning, or incremental learning techniques.
Experience optimizing model training, inference performance, and distributed computing workloads.
Knowledge of cloud-native technologies, containerization, and orchestration platforms.
Experience contributing to open-source projects or working with open-source technologies.
Familiarity with observability platforms, monitoring systems, and performance tuning methodologies.
